messages:
Alex: Quick sync — RC candidate 0.23.0-rc1 is green on staging. CI passed, smoke looks good. We need final signoffs for security, docs, and QA before cutoff at 18:00 PT.
Maya: Copy. I'm gating on two things: (1) changelog entry from each owner, (2) QA smoke + flaky check cleared. Can owners drop brief confirmations here? :eyes: 
Devon: QA smoke ran now, no high-severity flakes. Ran `./scripts/smoke.sh --suite=regression --env=staging` — 42/42 passed, one flaky test flagged (search/indexing) that we've quarantined. Marking as OK with note.
Sam: Quick security peek done — dependency scan shows one low-sev transitive in the analytics lib (GHSA-xxxx). We'll patch in the next minor, not blocking RC. I left a comment in the PR. Approve from security side.
Chris: Docs: updated changelog entry and release notes draft at `docs/CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/release-notes/0.23.md`. Small note: calling out breaking change for embedding endpoint. Patch PR #1428.
Maya: Thanks. Can someone run the version bump script so the artifacts align? Prefer `0.23.0-rc1` for the tag.
Alex: I'll run it in a minute. Command I use:```bash
./scripts/bump-version.sh 0.23.0-rc1 && git push origin HEAD:release/0.23 && hub release create -t "0.23.0-rc1" -a dist/*.tar.gz v0.23.0-rc1
```
Devon: Reminder to notify infra about the brief canary window. We should route 5% of traffic for 30m, watch latency P95 and error rate.
Maya: @release-bot please schedule canary at 17:30 PT for 30m and set rollback if error_rate > 1% OR p95 > 300ms.
release-bot: Scheduled: Canary for release v0.23.0-rc1 at 2026-03-17T17:30:00-07:00 for 30m. Auto-rollback triggers: error_rate > 1% OR p95 > 300ms. Notifying infra and oncall.
Sam: Also add a quick runtime CVE check on the final artifact: `trivy image --severity CRITICAL,HIGH dist/release.tar.gz` — I will run it post-bump.
Alex: Bumped version, pushed branch `release/0.23`, created tag v0.23.0-rc1. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/releases/tag/v0.23.0-rc1
Chris: Docs PR merged. Changelog entry looks good.
Devon: Canary will be started by infra at 17:30 PT. QA on standby for smoke at +5m.
Maya: Final checklist: 
- [x] Changelog entries merged
- [x] QA smoke ok
- [x] Security quick-scan ok
- [x] Docs updated
- [ ] Product sign-off (pending)
- [x] Version bumped and tag created

Product: @alex / @maya can you confirm final sign-off?
Alex: Confirmed from eng side. Happy to ship if product gives final OK.
Maya: Product pinged in product channel and emailed PM. Waiting on thumbs-up. If we don't hear by 17:50 PT, we'll proceed with scheduled cut assuming implicit approval per SLAs.
release-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-17T17:30:00-07:00. Routing 5% traffic to release/0.23.
Devon: First 5m smoke: no errors, p95 stable at 120ms. Continuing monitoring.
Sam: Trivy result: no CRITICAL/HIGH. Safe to proceed.
Product: Thumbs up from PM — ok to ship. :thumbsup:
Maya: Great. Rolling cutoff at 18:00 PT. Post-merge hotpatch path: if rollback required, revert tag and `kubectl rollout undo` for frontend and api deployments, then open hotfix branch `hotfix/0.23.0-<reason>`.
Alex: Noted. Thanks team — I'll watch the cutover and post a short postmortem if anything pops.
Chris: I'll push the final release notes live after GA is confirmed.
release-bot: Release v0.23.0-rc1 cutoff executed at 2026-03-17T18:00:00-07:00. Artifacts promoted to GA staging.
Maya: Closing thread — tagging in post-release checklist in #eng-releases-ops later. :party-parrot:
